notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 8 of 32 text layers are full attention (text_config layer_types: 8 full_attention, 24 linear_attention, full_attention_interval 4). 8 x 4 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 32,768 B/token (32.0 KiB). head_dim 256 is explicit and includes the 64 dims that actually carry RoPE (partial_rotary_factor 0.25), so no KV saving comes from the partial rotary - the cache holds all 256. The 24 linear-attention layers keep a fixed-size state, not per-token KV. The vision tower is a single pass. context_tokens is text_config.max_position_embeddings. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card benchmark table lists all six rows with matching Qwen3.5-4B values.
